Event.metaTitle: Calendar of Events (COE) | TIC Bandung City
Event.metaDesc: Annual event schedule and official event registration for Bandung City.
Event.heroDesc: An annual agenda curating the best events in Bandung City. Discover various festivals, art performances, and cultural celebrations throughout the year.
Event.timeline1Desc: Organizers submit proposals and supporting documents.
Event.timeline4Desc: Official announcement before the Disparbud calendar is released.
Event.criteria1: For events entering the Top 10, they must have a track record of being held in Bandung City for 3 consecutive years.
Event.criteria2: Organizers are willing and required to report event results after completion.
Event.criteria3: Must include a track record of previous event promotional media (Flyers, Logos, Photos, & Videos).
Event.criteria4: The form format is adjusted to the KEN (Karisma Event Nusantara) standard from Kemenparekraf.
Event.registerDesc: Make your event part of the main tourism attraction of Bandung City in 2027.
Event.registerTerms: By registering, you agree to the CoE curation terms & conditions of Bandung City.
